name: Linux kernel
about: The newest release on each Linux kernel line we track. Each one fixes every Linux kernel bug we cover, except the bugs listed below as not fixed yet.
older: Ubuntu 26.10: 7.3.0-10.10. Cloud and HWE kernels have their own versions.

unfixed.note: No stable kernel has the SCTP fix yet (merged into mainline 19 Nov, first in the 7.4-rc4 test release; not in the 23 Nov stable releases and not queued for the next ones on 24 Nov). Block the sctp module meanwhile.

unfixed.line: All lines except Debian 13 and RHEL 8
unfixed.note: The socket race (CVE-2026-99676) is fixed upstream in 6.12.118, 6.18.64 and 7.3.5 and in Debian 13's 6.12.118-1; Debian 12 and Ubuntu still list it as vulnerable, and Red Hat has deferred the fix for RHEL 9 and 10 (RHEL 8 isn't affected).
NoisyTCP (CVE-2026-99288) has no released fix yet for Ubuntu (in progress), RHEL 10.2 or RHEL 9.8 EUS. RHEL 9.9 is fixed.

Nfs2root (CVE-2026-99362) is fixed in Debian 13's 6.12.117-1 and Debian 12's optional linux-6.12 6.12.117-1~deb12u1. Debian 12's default 6.1 kernel, Ubuntu (fixes in progress for 26.04 and 26.10) and RHEL 6 to 10 have no fix yet.
